column1: # Applications, by the name a person says.
# An entry here is the ONLY way an application reaches a machine. There is no free-text package
# field anywhere in a recipe, so this file is the whole vocabulary of installation.
#   name        exactly as it is written in a recipe's apps: list. No digits — see $defs/appName.
#   ref         the Flatpak application id, or the rpm package name
#   group       the removable group this belongs to, or - if it belongs to none.
#               If a recipe installs this app AND removes this group, that is a contradiction and
#               the validator refuses it rather than picking one.
#               A capability is a door. An app that opens a terminal on a locked fleet defeats the
#               policy by being installed, which no schema rule can see, so validate.ts checks it.
